provenance.source: JPL Phoebe orbit and the retained Gaskell source-model orientation; the 2023 release uses the same image/kernel set and shifts its origin to the center of figure. Present-day rotation phase is not independently qualified.
provenance.qualification: Computed Phoebe Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
